metadata.translation_note: Chinese wording follows the Stanford Chinese GDS-15 publication; English prompts preserve source-content review traceability.

items.question_en: Are you basically satisfied with your life?
items.question_zh: 你对自己的生活基本上满意吗？

items.question_en: Have you dropped many of your activities and interests?
items.question_zh: 你是否已放弃了自己的很多活动和兴趣？

items.question_en: Do you feel that your life is empty?
Are you in good spirits most of the time?
items.question_zh: 你是否常常感到精神不错，精神还可以？

items.question_en: Are you afraid that something bad is going to happen to you?
items.question_zh: 你是否害怕会有不好的事情发生在你身上呢？

items.question_en: Do you feel happy most of the time?
items.question_zh: 你大部分时间心情还可以吗？

items.question_en: Do you prefer to stay at home, rather than going out and doing new things?
items.question_zh: 你是否宁愿留在家里，而不外出并做些新的事呢？

items.question_en: Do you feel you have more problems with memory than most?
items.question_zh: 你是否觉得你的记忆力比多数人差？

items.question_en: Do you think it is wonderful to be alive now?
items.question_zh: 你是否觉得活着真好，活着还不错？

items.question_en: Do you feel pretty worthless the way you are now?
items.question_zh: 你是否觉得自己现在很没用呢？

items.question_en: Do you feel full of energy?
items.question_zh: 你是否感到精力充足，精力足够应付日常的生活？

items.question_en: Do you feel that your situation is hopeless?
items.question_zh: 你是否觉得自己的处境没有希望？

items.question_en: Do you think that most people are better off than you are?
items.question_zh: 你是否觉得多数人都比你活得好吗？
